slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: Managed IT in Cardiff: common questions

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Not covered here? Ask us directly — same working day response.

slots.label: Question 1
slots.default: Do you have an office in Cardiff?

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: No. Our offices are at 124 City Rd in London and Caxton Point in Stevenage, and we are straight about that rather than listing a virtual address. Cardiff is covered by our UK service desk plus a team of field engineers who travel to customer sites. In practice most issues never need a visit at all: we respond the same working day and resolve most issues remotely. When a site visit is requested, we aim to have an engineer with you the same working day.

slots.label: Question 2
slots.default: We handle sensitive client data. How do you approach security?

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: We hold Cyber Essentials certification ourselves and can take you through it, which matters because your provider is part of your attack surface. Day to day it means enforced multi-factor authentication, managed endpoint protection, email security, patching on a schedule and backups that are tested by restoring from them.

slots.label: Question 3
slots.default: Can you support hybrid teams working across South Wales?

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: Yes, and it is the norm now rather than the exception. Support follows the person rather than the desk: devices are managed and monitored wherever they are, access is secured with multi-factor authentication, and the service desk does not care which building someone is sitting in.

slots.label: Question 4
slots.default: Do you work with financial and professional services firms?

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: Yes. What those businesses tend to need is unglamorous and non-negotiable: email that always works, files available and version-controlled, tight access control and backups that can be proven. We are a Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider, so Microsoft 365 and Azure are handled directly rather than through a reseller chain.

slots.label: Paragraph 6
slots.default: We start with an assessment of your current systems and what the business actually needs, agree a support plan, deploy the tooling we use for remote assistance, monitoring and patching, then go live. You get a named point of contact rather than a ticket portal and nothing else.
